name: Nils Ušakovs, Michalis Hadjipantela - Après le § 25 - Am 46
title: REPORT on the Council position on the draft general budget of the European Union for the financial year 2027
part_text: 25c. Creates a Union Fund for Peace and Diplomacy and allocates EUR 500 million in commitment appropriations to it; considers that the Fund should strengthen the Union’s capacity for conflict prevention, mediation, facilitation of negotiations, support for ceasefire and peace processes, preventive diplomacy, early warning, confidence-building measures, inclusive dialogue and the peaceful resolution of disputes; stresses that its actions should contribute to addressing the root causes of conflict and should support the meaningful participation of civil society, local peacebuilders, women and young people in peace processes; stresses that the Fund for Peace and Diplomacy complements, rather than replaces, existing humanitarian, development and neighbourhood assistance funding programmes;
